purpose: Observe only the two bound failing convolution-weight coordinates, separating selected upstream adjoints and native-versus-CPU local reduction without training or altering the original gate

target.identityRule: jointly verify index/name/parameter graph/module type/source SHA/weight bytes and before-after versions; shape alone is insufficient
target.historicalVersionRule: Record actual fresh-instance versions; do not fabricate them to match archived counters
target.convolutionConfiguration: Bind actual native Conv2d: batch1, input[1,144,192,256], output[1,48,192,256], kernel3x3/stride1/pad1/dilation1/groups1/zeros; retain only one selected channel plane of each.

definitions.A: Two selected coordinates of the observed native actualTotal target gradient, cast to FP64 only for arithmetic
definitions.Bi: Two selected coordinates of each of four native component target gradients cast to FP64
definitions.E: Two selected coordinates of the original ordered FP32 sum of four native component gradients, then cast to FP64
definitions.T: CPU FP64 product with stable summation for the two coordinates using the selected input plane and actualTotal output-adjoint plane
definitions.Si: Four CPU FP64 selected-coordinate references using each component adjoint plane
definitions.S: Ordered FP64 sum of the four Si
definitions.B: Ordered FP64 sum of the four native FP32 component values at the two selected coordinates

comparison.interpretation: Only the two selected coordinates in this new observation are covered. T-S observes selected upstream contribution; A-T and B-S compare native gradients to finite-precision local references; B-E is final component-sum rounding. Decomposition is evidence, not a proof of implementation error, necessary FP64 repair, complete-model cause or historical replay. Hooks and host synchronization may perturb timing. No threshold changes.
comparison.upstreamRule: Retain exact original FP32 selected planes, check identity/finiteness and count; record selected-plane hashes and signed contractions. Other channels and coordinates are outside this diagnosis.

cpuPreparation.scope: bound archive/state/sample identity, synthetic observer and exact request ABI; no real forward

stopRules: Only authentic unchanged full108 original gate failure at target48 and both bound coordinates over original tolerance with five complete same-call captures permit local reference after first-error preservation
No optimizer, D gradient/update, model modification, train restart, Checkpoint selection/save or image output
No validation/challenge/regression asset content, extra sample, extra layer or extra coordinate
Gate pass, other gate position, either selected coordinate not reproduced, mutation or incomplete evidence closes the one attempt without local reference or retry
Cleanup must be from this invocation's live native proof, not historical files or vanished PID
acceptance: Exact current policy, formal version, original source graph, interpreter, failed state and sample plus own CPU synthetic behaviour match
One original G forward and five G gradient groups; no D gradient, optimizer or updates
Actual module geometry, original selected coordinates, independent copies, versions/modes/sample/RNG verified; no historical replay claim
First original gate error and selected FP32 evidence committed before bounded CPU reference
Real total timing, bytes, stream and managed cleanup accounted; completion/not-reproduced/failure closes the attempt

localContrastPermittedOnlyIf: All five original G gradients complete in the original order
Unchanged actual gate source, function code, traceback and parameter48 locals match these same-call target gradients
Both [10,81,0,0] and [10,81,1,0] exceed the unchanged original absolute/relative tolerance
All selected input/adjoint planes and target native gradients finite, exact identity and copies preserved
Original first error and target capture persisted before any local reference; state unchanged and resources remain
gateFailureContinuation.whenExactTargetFailure: Preserve original error and same-call capture before local math; never return reference gradients to training
gateFailureContinuation.whenOtherFailure: diagnostic_failed_closed, or diagnostic_not_reproduced for selected-coordinate non-reproduction; neither performs local reference

captureBudget.rule: Enforce actual aggregate target archive/metadata/error/reference <=64MiB; all output including host, native builds, registry, streams, atomic temporary bytes and closure <=128MiB. Estimates do not grant admission. Never serialize or copy the original full archive to new output.

captureRestrictions.upstreamDifference: Only channel81 input and channel10 adjoint planes for the two bound coordinates; no second full activation or global-gradient capture.

accounting: phase budgets include startup, restore, math, native supervision, closure, source/build copies, logs, stream output and receipts. Original archive is read-only input, not copied into target capture. Safe decompression is independently bounded by the authenticated archive metadata and decoder's original hard limits.
sourceGraphRule: Collect actual original and new diagnostic program closure with paths and recomputed SHA, at most256 entries; authenticate loaded modules and exact current CPU evidence. Prior parameter60 or saved-gradient CPU success grants no admission.
